statements.status_notes: This is an informational maintenance advisory with no patched release. The standalone crate is unmaintained; upstream recommends migrating to zbus 6. uv 0.13.7 depends on this crate. Compatibility and replacement work remain under investigation; no claim of runtime unreachability or a security fix is made. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0371.html.

RUSTSEC-2026-0371 is an informational notice that zbus_names is unmaintained as a standalone crate, not a specific security vulnerability. uv includes it transitively through secret-service and zbus 5.15 for Linux keyring support. No patched standalone release exists; remediation requires an upstream dependency migration to zbus 6 and remains under evaluation.
